'''Giant Flog''' was a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] owned by [[Kesivo]], during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. This warrior survived many battles, which gave rise to wild tales, including stories that Flog was a [[Demon/Legends|demon]] summoned by occult means, while others claimed he was patched together from the parts of dead gladiators. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Giant Flog fought in the [[the Cauldron]] arena on the forsaken world of [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]], where he was slain by the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding warrior [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].

==Biography==
===Undefeated champion===
[[File:Giant_flog.jpg|280px|left|thumb|Giant Flog was a furious arena titan who crushed other gladiators with a craggy hunk of stone]]
During the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Kesivo]], a hidden benefactor and owner of warriors involved in the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] games, carried out a fruitful trading mission to the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]. Any other details of this trip were veiled in mystery, except for the fact that Kesivo purchased a new combatant there known only as Giant Flog.<ref name="DB" /> The opportunity to realize his violent potential came<ref name="CW">{{CW|6}}</ref> on the forsaken world of [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]], where brutal violence was an everyday reality, far from the laws of the Republic.<ref name="BS">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20031119.html|text=The Blood-sport of Rattatak}}</ref>

[[File:GiantFlogRoars.jpg|250px|right|thumb|Giant Flog shouts in rage]]
Few Rattatak gladiators enjoyed careers that spanned [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], let alone [[Standard year/Legends|years]], but the simple brute Giant Flog survived the bloody circuit for nearly two standard years and proved to be the most profitable fighter for Kesivo. Surrounding patrons knew almost nothing about Giant Flog or his mysterious owner. This caginess led to countless rumors among the other patrons, and such unbridled speculation only fed Giant Flog's reputation. Wild tales included stories that Flog was a [[Demon/Legends|demon]] summoned by occult means, while others claimed that he had been stitched together from the parts of dead gladiators. Though [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], Giant Flog obeyed only Kesivo.<ref name="DB" />

Shortly after the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Giant Flog ended up in the [[the Cauldron]] arena.<ref name="CW" /> It was the largest gladiatorial pit on Rattatak, filled with violent warriors, where war barons and generals sought out the best combatants who would win their wars.<ref name="DBR">{{DB|location|rattatak|Rattatak}}</ref> Therefore, Giant Flog, like many other gladiators,<ref name="CW" /> entered a deadly free-for-all battle,<ref name="EGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> but it was a rare gladiator indeed who could survive multiple fights there.<ref name="DBR" />

===Fateful day===
[[File:DemiseOfGiantFlog.jpg|280px|left|thumb|The demise of Giant Flog]]
During one battle, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] attended a match in the Cauldron, hoping to find a new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] among the fighters. Soon, the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], seeking to prove herself a worthy disciple of Count Dooku, entered the arena and, in a short time, defeated most of the remaining gladiators. The survivors united for a single attack against Ventress, but she used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to crush stone debris from the ceiling onto their heads. The [[Cauldron wampa|wampa]] was the only one who managed to get close enough to Ventress to strike. However, at that very moment Giant Flog knocked the creature aside with his own craggy hunk of stone and then continued the battle with her. Ventress activated her paired [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] to sever the chain holding Flog's mace.<ref name="CW" /> The liberated chunk of stone soared through the air, and crashed into the viewing box holding Kesivo.<ref name="DB" /> Enraged by this, Flog rushed at Ventress in fury, only to be felled by her twin lightsabers.<ref name="CW" /> Giant Flog was the last warrior to stand against her,<ref name="DB" /> and Ventress went on to claim victory in the arena, becoming Dooku's apprentice.<ref name="CW7">{{CW|7}}</ref>

==Personality==
[[File:AttackOfGiantFlog.jpg|280px|right|thumb|Giant Flog rushes into battle]]
Giant Flog was a mysterious [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] whose origins remained unknown to most. Unlike many arena patrons who boasted about their fighters, his owner [[Kesivo]] was notably secretive, and this caginess fueled countless rumors and wild speculation among other patrons. Such stories only enhanced Flog's fearsome reputation, with some claiming he was a [[Demon/Legends|demon]] summoned through occult means, while others insisted he was stitched together from the remains of dead gladiators. Though [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], Giant Flog possessed little command of language; his coarse voicebox could produce only a few words in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] – including his crude name – and he obeyed only Kesivo.<ref name="DB" />

In battle he favored a crude weapon: a craggy hunk of stone attached to a chain, which he swung like a primitive mace. Few gladiators on [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] survived the brutal arena circuit for long, yet the simple brute Giant Flog endured nearly two standard [[Standard year/Legends|years]], becoming Kesivo's most profitable combatant.<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Giant Flog<ref name="DB" /> first appeared as an unnamed background character in the [[Chapter 6 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|sixth chapter]]<ref name="CW" /> of ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'', an animated television micro-series<ref name="Chapter Archive">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/microseries/chapter/archive.html|text=View ''Clone Wars'' Chapter Archive}}</ref> produced by [[Cartoon Network]] Studios<ref name="Volume One">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume One|''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' Volume One]]</ref> and originally aired on [[November 14]], [[2003]].<ref name="TV">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-clone-wars/chapter-vi-276612|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars - Season 1, Episode 6: Chapter VI}}</ref> The character was later given a name and short backstory in the personal [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry on the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' website, [[StarWars.com]], in [[2003]].<ref name="DB" />

The species of Giant Flog is not specified in any official source; however, it is known that he was purchased in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]],<ref name="DB" /><ref name="CE" /> where the giant race known as [[Phlog/Legends|phlog]] lived.<ref name="CEIII">{{CSWECite|III|23|Phlog}}</ref> Another interesting observation is that in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', an illustration of a gladiatorial arena on the planet [[Loovria/Legends|Loovria]] features a character who bears many visual similarities to Giant Flog.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
